[Story]
Li Qiang attends the live concert of his favorite rock band. The band starts to play, and Li Qiang dances with the music, completely immerses in the atmosphere.

[Question]
Li Qiang should be very excited at the concert, but he seems a bit sad, why?

[Candidate Answers]
A. The band plays the love song of Li Qiang and his ex-girlfriend, which makes him remember the past.
B. Li Qiang meets someone he does not like at the concert, which affects his mood.
C. Li Qiang finds that the live performance of the band is not as wonderful as he expects, which hits him.
D. The sound effect at the concert is very poor.
